If you're using an iPhone 16 or newer model, you might want to find a Qi2.2 charger so your device can take full advantage of its supported 25W MagSafe charging speeds. Anker's newly released 25W Prime MagSafe 3-in-1 charger is one excellent option, and its design is extremely portable.

第一印象

The major trend in the second half of 2025 is bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory, and this trend continues into 2026. Anker has kicked things off with an all-new portable MagSafe 3-in-1 charger, incorporating 25W Qi2.2 support into an extremely portable design.

To achieve 25W wireless charging, active cooling is almost essential. Almost every 25W charger on the market comes equipped with this feature, and Anker's new foldable 3-in-1 charger is no exception.

The package includes a 45W charger and a USB-C cable—enough to simultaneously charge your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch. With this charging stand, you can charge your iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you once loved that product but it was later discontinued by Apple, you'll probably love this one. Its portability is remarkably similar to the MagSafe Duo, but it has two major advantages: it can be used as a stand, and it can charge three devices simultaneously rather than two.

This charger has a rather interesting (though admittedly somewhat unnecessary) feature—the Apple Watch charger uses a spring-loaded design. When you fold the charger closed, it retracts inward; but when you're ready to unfold it, you just press down once and it pops out. I think this design is quite clever and also helps justify the product's premium price tag.

總結

Overall, if you're looking for a stylish and portable MagSafe 3-in-1 charger, this new Anker product is a very good choice. With active cooling built in, it can charge your iPhone quickly without overheating or causing other side effects that wireless charging sometimes brings.

Anker's brand-new 3-in-1 MagSafe charger is now available on Amazon for US$99 with Prime shipping, offered in black and white color options.
